ad_info.structure_source: library format F43 (Fondo oscuro con sirena de urgencia, lista de 3 ofertas y botón) — estructuras/mv-13.json
ad_info.reference_style: Dark premium still-life offer ad: huge 4-line headline top left, short context paragraph, 3-item offer list with icons, wide button, big bottle with a glowing siren behind it
ad_info.angle_used: Oferta / promoción — the goodbye is not to a price but to the jeans that hang loose at the back (pain: already bought pills online and saw nothing)

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: near-black plum #1A0A17 background and deep palm green #1F4A2E for the leaves.
global_identity.visual_style: Dark premium still life with a real glowing fuchsia siren, the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo, and an inset real phone photo of the pain moment.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Urgent but warm: a fuchsia glow cutting through a near-black plum set, decisive, never alarmist.
global_identity.graphic_language: Huge stacked uppercase headline, simple white line icons, a wide rounded fuchsia button, a thin white-framed photo inset, a bordered registration badge.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look).

creative_objective: Stop the scroll of a woman who already wasted money on pills: the big 'goodbye' headline turns the offer into saying goodbye to the jeans that hang loose at the back, the inset shows her exact moment in the mirror, and the 3-item list plus the button make the complete 3-month treatment with cash on delivery feel like a low-risk decision.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the 4-line headline with ADIÓS in fuchsia, 2) the bottle with the glowing siren and the mirror inset, 3) the short paragraph, 4) the 3-item offer list, 5) the wide button and the registration badge.
art_direction.composition_style: Left column (0–56% of the width) carries all the text stacked; right column carries the photo inset on top and the big bottle below with the siren glowing behind it; the button runs across the bottom left.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Tight stacked headline, clear gaps between headline, paragraph and list; 5% margins on every edge; the bottle never touches the right edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Dark set lit by a fuchsia rim light from the right and the siren glow behind the bottle; soft top fill on the label; palm leaves slightly out of focus behind; the inset photo lit by daylight.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 45%: a 4-line white headline top left with the goodbye word in color, then a 4-line context paragraph in white with a bold phrase; on the top right, a real phone-photo inset of the pain moment. Middle 35%: on the left, 3 offer lines each with a white icon (hand pointing, cart, gift); on the right, the big bottle with palm leaves around its base and a glowing fuchsia siren behind it. Bottom 20%: wide rounded fuchsia button on the left with a bordered registration badge beside it.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium dark still-life offer ad. BACKGROUND: near-black plum #1A0A17 with a deep magenta #B0105E glow rising from the lower right, subtle grain, a dark slate surface at the bottom right where the bottle stands. TOP ZONE (0–52% height). LEFT (5–56% width): 4-line stacked headline, very tight leading, Montserrat Black uppercase, huge (each line about 9% of the canvas height): line 1 white #FFFFFF, line 2 hot fuchsia #E6177F with a faint fuchsia glow (the goodbye word), lines 3 and 4 white. Under it (39–51% height), a 4-line context paragraph in white Poppins Regular, about 3% of the canvas height per line, with the phrase 'un plan completo' in Poppins Bold bubblegum pink #FF8CC0. RIGHT (54–97% width, 3–52% height): a real smartphone photo inset with a thin 6 px white frame, slightly rotated 2 degrees, with a soft drop shadow: a Colombian woman around 30, light-brown skin with visible pores and natural texture, dark wavy hair in a loose clip, white ribbed tank top and light-wash mid-blue jeans one size too big at the back, standing back three-quarters to a full-length hallway mirror at home, holding her phone up with one hand, the other hand pinching the empty fabric at the back pocket, the seat of the jeans sagging flat with a horizontal fold of extra denim under the pockets, she looks over her shoulder at the mirror with pursed lips and a tired, let-down look; daylight from a side window, a little hallway clutter, real phone sharpness. MIDDLE ZONE (54–80% height). LEFT (5–55% width): 3 offer lines stacked, each with a simple white line icon on the left (1: a hand pointing right, 2: a shopping cart, 3: a gift box) and text in white Montserrat ExtraBold condensed uppercase, about 5% of the canvas height. RIGHT (55–95% width, 50–95% height): the real product bottle standing upright, front view at label height, about 42% of the canvas height, label fully facing the camera and readable; a hot fuchsia #E6177F rim light from the right outlines its edge; directly behind and above it (upper right of the bottle, 40–62% height) a real glossy fuchsia rotating warning siren lamp on a dark base, switched on, casting a soft fuchsia glow and a few light rays onto the background, no text on it; dark green aguaje palm fronds (long pleated fan leaves, deep green #1F4A2E) rise behind the bottle base, slightly out of focus, plus two whole aguaje fruits (egg-sized, glossy maroon-brown overlapping scales) at its foot; soft contact shadow on the slate. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Always closed with its cap on; no loose capsules; the label reads the right way round, never mirrored. BOTTOM ZONE (83–95% height): LEFT (5–56% width): a wide rounded-pill button in solid hot fuchsia #E6177F with a subtle inner highlight, white Montserrat Black uppercase text centered with a small white arrow; RIGHT of it (58–90% width): a rounded rectangular badge with a dark plum #2B1226 fill, a solid 3 px hot-fuchsia border and a small white shield line icon on the left, the registration text in white Poppins Bold uppercase on two lines. All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents and Spanish punctuation, nothing else written anywhere.

mandatory_visual_elements: Real phone-photo inset top right (at least 25% of the canvas): woman at a hallway mirror in loose light-wash jeans sagging at the back, pinching the empty fabric, tired look over her shoulder
Glowing fuchsia siren lamp behind the bottle, switched on, no text
The real closed product bottle, front view, label readable, about 42% of the canvas height
Aguaje palm fronds and two whole aguaje fruits at the bottle's base
White line icons: hand pointing, shopping cart, gift box
Wide hot-fuchsia button with 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and a bordered registration badge at the bottom
final_generation_exclusions: No capsules or pills anywhere; no open bottle; no other brand or product
No prices, percentages, '2+1', guarantees, ratings, testimonials, countdowns or 'últimas unidades'
No logos; never write the words 'AGREGAR' or 'LOGO Y SELLO DE'
No text on the siren; no red that reads as a medical alarm, the siren is fuchsia
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add prices, extra badges, ratings, testimonials, discount labels or extra claims beyond the listed button, badge and texts.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. The goodbye is to a garment fit, not a body defect; no promised results, no false urgency, no guarantees, no medical claims; the past-pills reference is in second person as an experience, not an attribute.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
